methodology.actions: per-user sequential save/progress/remove, verified complete library read-back, reader document; concurrently across distinct users
methodology.pacing: 500ms after each action; batch barrier after all users complete their pair of actions
limitations: Closed-loop batches, not the original fixed-arrival mixed workload.
At most five ordinary synthetic accounts and one library item per account; one reader title.
Stage ordering and shared service state confound concurrency comparisons; lower five-user latency does not prove higher load improves performance.
First requests retained; this run does not independently classify cold versus hot starts.
No AI, export, reflection HTTP, catalog search capacity, or browser-rendering coverage.
Setup, health and identity checks are outside the 600 measured requests.
